name: Emberwright Adept
flavorText: She signs each rune with the flat of the blade, then lets the steel finish the sentence.
designDescription: Slender duelist in a split tabard, one ember-etched longsword and a high collar.

name: Cinder Warden
flavorText: The shield is scorched through, and still it is the last thing the line sees.
designDescription: Broad tower-shield knight with a cracked kiln-crest and a short warhammer.

name: Slagborn Pyromancer
flavorText: Born in the cooling trough, she has never once been cold.
designDescription: Hooded caster with a slag-iron staff and a loose furnace-orange sash.

name: Glass-Horn Charger
flavorText: Its horns are cooled glass; the sound they make on armour is the last warning anyone gets.
designDescription: Low four-legged charger with translucent horn blades and a molten mane.

name: Ash-Veil Assassin
flavorText: The veil is not for hiding. It is so no one sees the last face they will.
designDescription: Compact hooded assassin, twin curved knives, scarf tails like smoke.

name: Furnace Abbot
flavorText: He reads the names of the fallen into the coals so the forge remembers them.
designDescription: Stout robed abbot with a censer-staff, wide sleeves and an iron halo.

name: Obsidian Lancer
flavorText: The lance was quarried, not forged. It has never needed sharpening.
designDescription: Tall lancer in plated greaves, long obsidian spear with a fringe of ember glass.

name: Kiln Tyrant
flavorText: Its breath is the heat of the room it was built to defend.
designDescription: Squat walking kiln with chained fists, a furnace mouth and chimney crown.

name: Pyre Sovereign
flavorText: It does not arrive. The room simply becomes the inside of a pyre.
designDescription: Crowned drake with swept ember wings, a long furnace throat and a broken throne plate on its back.

name: Tidecaller Acolyte
flavorText: She can call a wave. On most days she is still practising the smaller version.
designDescription: Small robed acolyte holding a shell-topped stave, hair wrapped in wet cloth.

name: Reef Duelist
flavorText: Coral cuts are shallow. She has never needed a second one.
designDescription: Lean duelist with a coral sabre, bandaged off-hand and a finned shoulder guard.

name: Saltglass Siren
flavorText: Her last note hangs in the air long after the rest of her has gone.
designDescription: Floating figure in a salt-crusted gown, glass throat, halo of suspended droplets.

name: Brine Hound
flavorText: It runs with the tide and arrives before the sound of it.
designDescription: Low slick hound with finned forelegs, a brine-slick coat and a whip tail.

name: Abyssal Cartographer
flavorText: Every trench it charts is one more place the enemy cannot hide.
designDescription: Goggled cartographer with a floating chart-slate, weighted boots and a brass sextant.

name: Riptide Monk
flavorText: The tide does not block. It simply makes the next step impossible.
designDescription: Bare-armed monk with wave-wrapped forearms, a wide stance and a trailing sash.

name: Leviathan Shard
flavorText: A splinter of something that was already old when the sea was young.
designDescription: Hunched armour-plated shard of leviathan bone, barnacled shoulders and a single eye.

name: The Hollow Current
flavorText: It leaves nothing behind but a colder room and one fewer answer.
designDescription: Tall drifting spirit with a hollow ribcage of water, trailing tendrils and a drowned crown.

name: Thornwood Sentinel
flavorText: It was planted here before the border was drawn. It sees no reason to move.
designDescription: Bark-plated guard with a living thorn shield and moss beard.

name: Bramble Stalker
flavorText: The bramble moves first. The thorns arrive a moment later.
designDescription: Low thorn-backed predator with a whip-briar tail and leaf-blade jaws.

name: Mossback Warden
flavorText: Counting its rings is a task measured in dynasties.
designDescription: Wide rooted giant with a mossy shell back, stump fists and hanging vines.

name: Whisperleaf Oracle
flavorText: The leaves tell her what happens next. They are rarely polite about it.
designDescription: Slender oracle under a leaf canopy hood, holding a seed-pod censer.

name: Grove Harrier
flavorText: She moves through the grove without disturbing a single leaf, which is the only warning it gives.
designDescription: Lithe scout with a leaf cloak, paired short blades and a low forward stance.

name: Antlered Bulwark
flavorText: The antlers are for the first rank. The bulk is for everything behind it.
designDescription: Massive stag-like beast with branching antlers, a mossy mantle and plated forelegs.

name: Willow-Veil Priest
flavorText: The veil is woven from the tree that will eventually be her grave, and it is not yet in a hurry.
designDescription: Tall willowy figure behind a hanging veil, driftwood staff and root-wrapped feet.

name: Canopy Wyrm
flavorText: It nests above the canopy so that the whole forest hears it arrive.
designDescription: Long green wyrm with leaf-membrane wings, a serpentine neck and root-claw feet.

name: The First Bloom
flavorText: Every garden is a copy of this one, and every copy is a little less certain.
designDescription: Floating seed-heart inside a cage of pale petals, with trailing roots and a bright inner core.

name: Rubble Warden
flavorText: The armour was assembled from a wall. It remembers being difficult to get through.
designDescription: Small squat guard in mismatched stone plate with a door-shield.

name: Clayfist Brawler
flavorText: The fists are still wet. They will be stone by the time they land.
designDescription: Broad bare-knuckle fighter with oversized clay gauntlets and a wrapped torso.

name: Dust Sage
flavorText: He has been reading the same page for forty years, and it has not finished with him.
designDescription: Stooped sage with a sand-glass staff, layered desert robes and a shard crown.

name: Slatehorn Ram
flavorText: The horns are slate. The rest of it is considerably less brittle.
designDescription: Heavy mountain ram with layered slate horns, a stone-wool coat and iron-shod hooves.

name: Quarry Engineer
flavorText: She does not build walls. She finds the ones that are already there and improves them.
designDescription: Aproned engineer with a bucket-chain pack, stone-cutting pike and ear guards.

name: Obsidian Mason
flavorText: It lays its own replacement stones when they fall. The wall is never quite finished.
designDescription: Blocky obsidian golem with a mortar-paddle arm, chiselled seams and a keystone heart.

name: Tomb Colossus
flavorText: The tomb was built to keep it in. Nobody asked what it wanted.
designDescription: Huge burial colossus wrapped in carved bands, a sarcophagus back and a broken crown.

name: Crown of Dust
flavorText: The empire is gone. The crown has not been told.
designDescription: Floating hollow crown above a collapsing robe of dust, with an empty throne plate.

name: Copper Squire
flavorText: The sword is too long, the armour too bright, and the courage entirely dogged.
designDescription: Youthful squire in too-large copper plate with a straight short sword.

name: Lattice Artificer
flavorText: She builds the small machines that make the larger ones possible.
designDescription: Workshop artisan with a lattice frame pack, a brace of brass tools and a visored cap.

name: Razorline Duelist
flavorText: The wire is not a weapon. The wire is the line you are not allowed to cross.
designDescription: Slim duelist with a wire-blade, mirrored half-mask and a tailored coat.

name: Null-Choir Cantor
flavorText: The choir sings a note that removes the possibility of a next one.
designDescription: Masked cantor in a brass collar, holding a tuning-fork staff, with a split choral cape.

name: Ironstep Sentinel
flavorText: It has guarded the same doorway for a century, and the doorway has moved twice.
designDescription: Narrow iron sentinel with piston legs, a halberd arm and a sealed lamp face.

name: Stormforge Lancer
flavorText: The lance is a lightning rod. The rider is the storm that decided to keep it.
designDescription: Plated lancer with a coil-headed spear, storm fin crest and a short cape.

name: Clockwork Hydra
flavorText: Cut off a head and it winds another one. The spring is the only thing it truly loves.
designDescription: Brass hydra with three articulated necks, gear-jointed legs and a coiled mainspring back.

name: The Quiet Engine
flavorText: It has no sound, no exhaust and no explanation. It simply keeps the board exactly where it is.
designDescription: Symmetric black-metal engine with a ring core, floating counterweights and a sealed crown.

name: Oathstone Knight
flavorText: The stone remembers the words. That is the whole of the oath: be the part of the wall that does not move.
designDescription: Armoured human knight in quarried plate, a broad sword, a paved tower shield and a back-swept stone plume.

name: Ironvow Paladin
flavorText: Every rivet in the armour is a promise. She has never broken one, and the armour has never needed replacing.
designDescription: Tall human paladin in riveted silver plate, long cloak, a crescent-headed axe and a brass plume swept back over the helm.

name: Tidewall Sentinel
flavorText: He holds the causeway alone at low tide, and the sea has learned to wait.
designDescription: Broad-shouldered human knight in sea-glass plate and a long cape, carrying a hooked tide spear and a wave-crested shield.

name: Cinderwatch Knight
flavorText: She carries the watch-fire from post to post, and the axe is only there so nobody argues about the route.
designDescription: Human knight in ember-plated harness with a hafted axe, a brazier held in the off hand and a scorched spike crest.

name: Thornmarch Ranger
flavorText: She marks the trail with thorns so the ones behind her can find their way back. Most of them do.
designDescription: Lean human ranger in a hooded leather coat, a tall longbow, a quiver strap across the chest and a feather at the shoulder.

name: Glass Meridian
flavorText: A thin line of water, held perfectly still until it is not.

name: Saltwake Cut
flavorText: The reef teaches one lesson, repeatedly and with a blade.

name: Verdant Rebuke
flavorText: The forest does not object. It simply grows through the objection.

name: Granite Grasp
flavorText: Stone closes around the ankle and waits for the rest of the argument.

name: Null Manacle
flavorText: It is not a lock. It is the absence of anywhere to go.

name: Quickening Spark
flavorText: One spark is enough to remind a weapon what it is for.

name: Wake the Line
flavorText: The bell is rung once. The line answers as if it had never stopped.

name: Gravesong
flavorText: The tide brings back the name, and the name brings back the rest.

name: Reliquary Echo
flavorText: The tomb remembers the shape of a hero and returns it, slightly dustier.

name: Siphon Tithe
flavorText: The sea takes a portion of everything it touches.

name: Ashen Communion
flavorText: The fire offers a trade: their heat for yours.

name: Tidewall
flavorText: A wall of water is still a wall, and it is still yours.

name: Hearthlight
flavorText: Some fires are kept for warmth, not for war.

name: Flux Surge
flavorText: A brief, indecent amount of power arrives from somewhere it should not.

name: Wellspring Draught
flavorText: One mouthful and the whole day's work becomes possible.

name: Voltaic Veil
flavorText: The air becomes a decision that everyone on the field regrets.

name: Cinder Sweep
flavorText: The furnace doors open. The room is the furnace.

name: Searing Brand
flavorText: A mark that says: this one is worth hitting harder.

name: Stonehide Rite
flavorText: The skin remembers being mountainside.

name: Quillstorm
flavorText: Every map has a margin. This is what lives in it.

name: Last Light
flavorText: Not a sunrise. The other thing that happens at the end of a long day.

name: Sunder the Gate
flavorText: The gate was built to hold. It was not built to hold this.

name: Brass Standard
flavorText: Raised once, and the whole line remembers how to advance.

name: Tideglass Aegis
flavorText: The Nexus wears a shield made of the sea's most patient hour.

name: Ashwake Crown
flavorText: Every Vessel under it has already survived one burning.

name: Mountain Oath
flavorText: Sworn to a stone that has never once broken its word.

name: Swift Banner
flavorText: The banner is always already moving when the order arrives.

name: Dawnroot Idol
flavorText: At first light the roots carry a little of the forest into whoever is still standing.

name: Quicklime Sigil
flavorText: A thin crust of chalk that makes every blow cost more.

name: Oracular Prism
flavorText: It shows the next card. It is not interested in whether you wanted to see it.
